description_en: Queries the discovery time of the latest system vulnerability

name: DescribeSupervisonInfo

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder. The ID is an Alibaba Cloud account ID.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to query the value of this parameter

资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数

LatestScanTime.description_en: The time when the system vulnerability scanning was performed. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
LatestScanTime.description_zh: 系统漏洞扫描时间。时间戳，单位毫秒
